# Aptabase MAUI SDK

> .NET MAUI SDK for Aptabase: privacy-first, open-source analytics for cross-platform .NET apps. NuGet package: Aptabase.Maui

## Installation

Install via NuGet:

```
dotnet add package Aptabase.Maui
```

Or add to your `.csproj`:

```xml
<PackageReference Include="Aptabase.Maui" Version="0.1.0" />
```

## Initialization

Configure Aptabase in your `MauiProgram.cs` using the `UseAptabase` extension method:

```csharp
using Microsoft.Maui.Hosting;

public static class MauiProgram
{
    public static MauiApp CreateMauiApp()
    {
        var builder = MauiApp.CreateBuilder();
        builder
            .UseMauiApp<App>()
            .UseAptabase("<YOUR_APP_KEY>");

        return builder.Build();
    }
}
```

This registers `IAptabaseClient` in the DI container. Inject it into pages or view models via constructor injection.

## Track Events

Inject `IAptabaseClient` and call `TrackEvent`:

```csharp
using Aptabase.Maui;

public partial class MainPage : ContentPage
{
    private readonly IAptabaseClient _aptabase;

    public MainPage(IAptabaseClient aptabase)
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        _aptabase = aptabase;
    }

    private void OnStarted(object sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        _aptabase.TrackEvent("app_started");
    }
}
```

Register your page in the DI container in `MauiProgram.cs`:

```csharp
builder.Services.AddSingleton<MainPage>();
```

## Track Events with Properties

Pass a `Dictionary<string, object>` as the second argument. Only string and numeric values are supported:

```csharp
_aptabase.TrackEvent("screen_view", new() {
    { "name", "Settings" }
});

_aptabase.TrackEvent("purchase", new() {
    { "product", "Premium" },
    { "price", 9.99 }
});
```

## Configuration

Pass `AptabaseOptions` as the second argument to `UseAptabase`:

```csharp
builder.UseAptabase("<YOUR_APP_KEY>", new AptabaseOptions
{
    Host = "https://self-hosted.example.com",  // Self-hosted instances only
    IsDebugMode = true,                        // Enable debug mode
    EnablePersistence = true,                  // Persist events to disk before sending
    EnableCrashReporting = true,               // Log unhandled exceptions as events
});
```

| Option | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Host` | `string?` | Custom host URL for self-hosted Aptabase instances (app keys starting with `A-SH-`) |
| `IsDebugMode` | `bool?` | Enable debug-specific logging. Commonly set via `#if DEBUG` preprocessor directive |
| `EnablePersistence` | `bool?` | Persist events on disk before sending to server. Recommended when crash reporting is enabled |
| `EnableCrashReporting` | `bool?` | Log unhandled exceptions as TrackEvent calls with stack trace frames |

## Platform Notes

- Supports all .NET MAUI platforms: Android, iOS, macOS, Windows
- `TrackEvent` is non-blocking and runs in the background
- The SDK automatically captures OS, app version, and device metadata
- No events are tracked automatically — you control what gets sent
- `IAptabaseClient` implements `IAsyncDisposable`
- Only string and numeric property values are supported

## Cross-Discovery

For all Aptabase SDKs and documentation, see: https://aptabase.com/llms.txt
